parole.significato: bastard sturgeon, thorn sturgeon (Acipenser nudiventris, a fish of the genus Acipenser)
parole.testo: From Proto-Slavic *vyzъ (“European sturgeon”), with later loans likely from West Slavic, although Melnychuk posits that Ukrainian виз (vyz), is likely a borrowing from Polish wyz or Czech vyza, seemingly contradicting this claim
